mapper.select:
WITH VIEW_CONTENT_SCORE AS (
/* * 회원의 최근 30일 조회 이력을 * 콘텐츠 단위 점수로 먼저 합산합니다. * * VIEW_COUNT 자체는 실제 조회 횟수를 저장하지만 * 추천 계산에서는 LEAST를 사용해 * 같은 콘텐츠의 하루 조회를 최대 3회까지만 반영합니다. */ SELECT CVH.CONTENT_NO,
SUM( CASE WHEN CVH.VIEW_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 THEN LEAST(CVH.VIEW_COUNT, 3) * 2
ELSE LEAST(CVH.VIEW_COUNT, 3) END ) AS VIEW_SCORE
FROM CONTENT_VIEW_HISTORY CVH
WHERE CVH.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CVH.VIEW_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 29
GROUP BY CVH.CONTENT_NO ),
FAVORITE_CONTENT_SCORE AS (
/* * 현재 찜 목록은 콘텐츠당 3점으로 계산합니다. * * 찜 생성 날짜와 관계없이 * 현재 찜 상태인 콘텐츠를 반영합니다. */ SELECT F.CONTENT_NO, 3 AS FAVORITE_SCORE, 1 AS FAVORITE_CONTENT_COUNT
FROM FAVORITE F
WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ),
MEMBER_INTEREST_CONTENT AS (
/* * 조회 콘텐츠와 찜 콘텐츠를 합칩니다. * * 한 콘텐츠가 조회와 찜 모두에 해당해도 * FULL OUTER JOIN을 통해 한 행으로 유지합니다. */ SELECT NVL( VCS.CONTENT_NO, FCS.CONTENT_NO ) AS CONTENT_NO,
NVL( VCS.VIEW_SCORE, 0 ) AS VIEW_SCORE,
NVL( FCS.FAVORITE_SCORE, 0 ) AS FAVORITE_SCORE,
NVL( FCS.FAVORITE_CONTENT_COUNT, 0 ) AS FAVORITE_CONTENT_COUNT
FROM VIEW_CONTENT_SCORE VCS
FULL OUTER JOIN FAVORITE_CONTENT_SCORE FCS ON FCS.CONTENT_NO = VCS.CONTENT_NO )
SELECT OP.PLATFORM_NO AS platformNo, OP.PLATFORM_NAME AS platformName, OP.LOGO_IMAGE AS logoImage, OP.SITE_URL AS siteUrl,
SUM( MIC.VIEW_SCORE ) AS viewScore,
SUM( MIC.FAVORITE_SCORE ) AS favoriteScore,
SUM( MIC.VIEW_SCORE + MIC.FAVORITE_SCORE ) AS totalScore,
COUNT( DISTINCT MIC.CONTENT_NO ) AS interestContentCount,
SUM( MIC.FAVORITE_CONTENT_COUNT ) AS favoriteContentCount
FROM MEMBER_INTEREST_CONTENT MIC
INNER JOIN CONTENT_PLATFORM CP ON CP.CONTENT_NO = MIC.CONTENT_NO
INNER JOIN OTT_PLATFORM OP ON OP.PLATFORM_NO = CP.PLATFORM_NO
WHERE OP.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y'
GROUP BY OP.PLATFORM_NO, OP.PLATFORM_NAME, OP.LOGO_IMAGE, OP.SITE_URL
ORDER BY totalScore DESC, interestContentCount DESC, favoriteContentCount DESC, OP.PLATFORM_NO

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
SELECT CVH.CONTENT_NO
FROM CONTENT_VIEW_HISTORY CVH
WHERE CVH.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CVH.VIEW_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 29
GROUP BY CVH.CONTENT_NO
UNION
SELECT F.CONTENT_NO
FROM FAVORITE F
WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT MIC.CONTENT_NO )
FROM (
SELECT CVH.CONTENT_NO
FROM CONTENT_VIEW_HISTORY CVH
WHERE CVH.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CVH.VIEW_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 29
GROUP BY CVH.CONTENT_NO
UNION
SELECT F.CONTENT_NO
FROM FAVORITE F
WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
) MIC
INNER JOIN CONTENT_PLATFORM CP ON CP.CONTENT_NO = MIC.CONTENT_NO
INNER JOIN OTT_PLATFORM OP ON OP.PLATFORM_NO = CP.PLATFORM_NO
WHERE OP.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND CP.PLATFORM_NO IN
#{platformNo}

SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT F.CONTENT_NO )
FROM FAVORITE F
INNER JOIN CONTENT_PLATFORM CP ON CP.CONTENT_NO = F.CONTENT_NO
INNER JOIN OTT_PLATFORM OP ON OP.PLATFORM_NO = CP.PLATFORM_NO
WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND OP.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND CP.PLATFORM_NO IN
#{platformNo}

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, C.TITLE AS title
FROM FAVORITE F
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = F.CONTENT_NO
INNER JOIN CONTENT_PLATFORM CP ON CP.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO
WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CP.PLATFORM_NO = #{platformNo}
ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, C.VIEW_COUNT DESC, C.CONTENT_NO DESC
FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, C.TITLE AS title
FROM CONTENT_VIEW_HISTORY CVH
INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = CVH.CONTENT_NO
INNER JOIN CONTENT_PLATFORM CP ON CP.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO
WHERE CVH.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CP.PLATFORM_NO = #{platformNo} AND CVH.VIEW_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6
GROUP BY C.CONTENT_NO, C.TITLE, C.VIEW_COUNT
ORDER BY SUM(CVH.VIEW_COUNT) DESC, C.VIEW_COUNT DESC, MAX(CVH.LAST_VIEWED_AT) DESC, C.CONTENT_NO DESC
FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
